about: Round 29 §P3: where a picked sentence lies in one drawn text of the story. src/lib/markdown/passageRange.ts is the rule; the web (passageRange.test.ts), iOS (PassageMarksTests) and Android (PassageMarksTest) run these cases alike. A case has a `leaf` (expect { start, end } in UTF-16 code units, end exclusive, or null) or `leaves` in the story's order (expect { leaf, start, end } or null). `cjkRanges`: the code points read as CJK, inclusive.

cases.name: crossing bold: the leaf is the words as drawn, the range runs through the strong run
cases.leaf: 箱子堆滿了客廳，我坐在地上，第一次覺得安靜是屬於自己的。窗外有人在慢慢地收衣服。
cases.sentence: 我坐在地上，第一次覺得安靜是屬於自己的。

cases.name: the quote's soft break after a CJK stop, kept as a line break
cases.leaf:
你不是失去了一個家，
你是多了一個可以回去的地方。
cases.sentence: 你不是失去了一個家，你是多了一個可以回去的地方。

cases.name: the quote's soft break drawn as a space (`， `)
cases.leaf: 你不是失去了一個家， 你是多了一個可以回去的地方。
cases.sentence: 你不是失去了一個家，你是多了一個可以回去的地方。

cases.name: crossing a link: the leaf draws a space before the link's words, the sentence has none
cases.leaf: 有些東西在打包的時候就決定留下了：舊沙發、一面有裂痕的鏡子，還有 一篇讀過很多次的文章。
cases.sentence: 舊沙發、一面有裂痕的鏡子，還有一篇讀過很多次的文章。

cases.name: twice in one leaf: the first
cases.leaf: 我走了進去。燈還亮著。我走了進去。

cases.name: twice in the story: the first leaf, in the story's order, that holds it
a Latin sentence, its spaces read as one
cases.leaf: The quiet after moving out  felt like mine — finally.
cases.sentence: The quiet after moving out felt like mine — finally.

cases.name: a Latin match on word edges: "at the door" is not inside "that the door"
cases.leaf: He said that the door was open, so we waited at the door.

cases.name: a Latin match ends on a word edge too
a character outside the Basic Multilingual Plane counts two code units
cases.leaf: 𠮷野家的燈還亮著。我走了進去。

cases.name: across two list items: not in either leaf
cases.sentence: 把書按照顏色排好 在窗台放一盆薄荷

cases.name: a literal * the renderer draws: not found
cases.leaf: 窗外有人在*慢慢地*收衣服。
cases.sentence: 窗外有人在慢慢地收衣服。
